ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) surface area with approximately 75% white pixels to 25% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated on the edges and markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a continuous border along the trailing edge and around the median notch. High-contrast linear black filaments and one distinct concentric ring are mapped across the white field of the lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped indentation with a narrow vertex and high vertical depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-amplitude serrations at the distal tips (likely barnacle-induced); moderate-frequency, lower-amplitude peaks and valleys along the central trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edges with a posterior-concave sweep toward the central notch on the trailing edge.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast dark clusters at the distal lobe tips consistent with encrustation; one distinct annular pigmentation ring on the upper-left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple unaligned, high-contrast linear black pixel disruptions (rake marks) distributed across the ventral white surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across both lobes and irregular textural accumulation at the distal fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique, isolated concentric circular pigmentation mark (annulus) located in the upper quadrant of the left lobe.
